prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pet archetype to bring to life on your desktop.", "Companion Choices"]
1: ["Create or Pick Your Pet Avatar", "Upload a custom pet photo or select one of our curated pet templates.", "Preset Templates", "Upload Custom Photo"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Discover how your pet lives, plays, and assists right on your screen."]
3: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Learn how to move, hide, or talk to your companion from your desktop bar.", "Press Alt+P to show/hide pet", "Right-click pet for interaction menu", "Got It!", "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!"]
4: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet & Sync Data", "Linking your account ensures your pet's traits, items, and memory are backed up safely.", "Signing in secures your pet across app updates and device changes."]
5: ["Don't worry! You can update your pet's name and details anytime in app settings."]
6: ["We will play a sound and alert you when your pet is ready on your desktop.", "Desktop Alert Active"]
7: ["Preparing Desktop Environment"]
8: ["Meet Your New Screen Companion", "Your pet lives right on your computer desktop, reacting to your day and keeping you company.", "Start Journey"]
9: ["Welcome Home! 3 Quick Things to Try", "Complete your first interactions to claim your companion starter badge.", "1. Drag pet to your favorite screen corner", "2. Double click pet to give a treat", "Starter Companion Unlocked!"]
